_doc: Vertical slice dressing (docs/plans/MASTER_BACKLOG.md scenario A + the road bandit camp). Every position is RELATIVE to its town: x = metres along the town's first-gate axis (outward), z = metres to the left of it; the ground height is sampled at build time. Relocatable with the town (new real-terrain world).

scenario_a.notes: house_bid = the town-kit home the bot enters (interior has chairs); the chair sit itself is WP-01 (player SmartObject sit).
